summary.text: Francis Thompson is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 19, which the legislature's member page lists as covering East Carroll, Madison, Morehouse, Richland, and West Carroll parishes. First elected in 2019, Francis Thompson sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development and Appropriations committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Francis Thompson's occupation as retired college professor, with degrees from Louisiana Technical University (B.S. and M.S.) and Northeast Louisiana University (Ed.D. and M.Ed.).

The House page lists Francis Thompson's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Appropriations (elected member), and Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
